notes: Proper OOM fix: streaming channel persistence. Live, VOD, and series channels are now fetched and persisted sequentially (fetch one type, insert into DB in a single transaction, release the list, then fetch the next type). This reduces peak heap from sum(live+VOD+series) to max(live, VOD, series) — typically 65MB instead of 180MB+ for large providers. insertChannelGroupAllRaw added alongside persistXtreamChannelsStreaming to handle per-type batched inserts with sort_index offsets. The largeHeap flag from 1.1.13 is retained as belt-and-suspenders.
